plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: brand badge, then the bottle at full height, then a wide text column, then a generous CTA on the right, so the eye moves brand → product → message → action.
Text leads: a large headline block on the left, the bottle at the centre-right as a visual pivot, and a brand column on the far right with the logo stacked above the CTA.
Editorial lockup: logo in the top-left corner, headline and subhead across the top, the CTA left-aligned under the copy with the fine print beside it, and the bottle anchoring the right edge.
